title: Trend of Singaporeans being Declared Bankrupt and Average Time to Exit Bankruptcy
what_it_is: Trend of Singaporeans being Declared Bankrupt and Average Time to Exit Bankruptcy

sections.label: Bankruptcy exit time and DRS
sections.summary: Average bankruptcy exit for Singaporeans is 9.7 years; the Debt Repayment Scheme cap will rise from $100,000 to $150,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: In the same period, the average time taken for Singaporeans to exit bankruptcy is 9.7 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The Debt Repayment Scheme (DRS) introduced in 2009, for instance, allows individuals with steady employment and whose unsecured debt do not exceed $100,000 to avoid bankruptcy by developing a repayment plan over a period of time with their creditors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: With the upcoming implementation of the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act, the cap will be raised from $100,000 to $150,000.

sections.label: First-time bankrupt discharge timeframe
sections.summary: First-time bankrupts who cooperate and contribute can generally be discharged within five to seven years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Under this framework, first-time bankrupts will generally be able to achieve discharge within a shorter timeframe of between five and seven years, if they cooperate by keeping to the conditions of bankruptcy and they also make the required contributions each time.

sections.label: Employers asking bankruptcy status
sections.summary: Employers asking an applicant's bankruptcy status at application must state job-related reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Where there are specific requirements to ask for an applicant's bankruptcy status at point of application, employers should state the reasons, which must be job-related.

sections.label: Bankrupt travel for work
sections.summary: The Office Assignee's discretion extends to allowing a bankrupt's overseas travel for job interviews or job requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Nonetheless, where a bankrupt is trying to look for a job, seek employment and perhaps that might require, say, for instance, travel overseas to attend an interview or it is part and parcel of his job to run an office overseas if that is part of his job requirement, then the Office Assignee's discretion will extend to allowing that travel to take place.

sections.label: DRS threshold raised
sections.summary: The DRS threshold will rise from $100,000 to $150,000, helping more persons avoid bankruptcy before creditors claim.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier also, under the arrangement for DRS, the threshold will be raised from $100,000 to $150,000 and that will facilitate more persons coming into the scheme to avoid bankruptcy even before creditors make the claim against them.
